record.title: OCEL v2 dual RevOps observability
record.body: R77 adds repository-universe adjacency to dual RevOps observation. RevenueFROMCustomer remains distinct from RevenueFORCustomer. New sensors require RevenueFROMCustomer evidence root, payer, causal capability, time window and attribution confidence; RevenueFORCustomer requires evidence root, beneficiary, causal capability, time window and attribution confidence. No independent live commercial evidence was observed in this run, therefore both revenue standings remain UNKNOWN[NO_LIVE_ECONOMIC_PROOF]. OCEL density vector remains numerically UNKNOWN for live portfolio; R77 adds an explicit completeness detector and new repository/head/displacement/fanout/throughput observation object classes so the next census can populate cross-repository, consumer, causal, economic, replay, and actionable-adjacency dimensions without prose inference.
